operationalLimits.limitDetails: The permittee shall operate and maintain each engine-generator set (Ref. Nos. ENG1-ENG114) and control device according to the manufacturer's written instructions or procedures developed by the permittee that are approved by the engine manufacturer. In addition, the permittee may only change those settings that are permitted by the manufacturer and does not increase air emissions.

The approved fuels for the engine-generator sets (Ref. Nos. ENG1-ENG114) are diesel, renewable diesel, or a blend of these fuels. The diesel and renewable diesel fuels shall meet the ASTM D975 specification for S15 diesel fuel oil with a maximum sulfur content per shipment of 0.0015%.

800,800 gallons diesel/renewable diesel per year. Each throughput shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period. Compliance for the consecutive 12-month period shall be demonstrated monthly by adding the total for the most recently completed calendar month to the individual monthly totals for the preceding 11 months.

4,858 gallons diesel/renewable diesel per year. Each throughput shall be calculated monthly as the sum of each consecutive 12-month period.
